تشاطرت (form VI)
# تَشَاطَرْتُ (tašāṭartu) /ta.ʃaː.tˤar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَشَاطَرَ (tašāṭara)
# تَشَاطَرْتَ (tašāṭarta) /ta.ʃaː.tˤar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَاطَرَ (tašāṭara)
# تَشَاطَرْتِ (tašāṭarti) /ta.ʃaː.tˤar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَاطَرَ (tašāṭara)
# تَشَاطَرَتْ (tašāṭarat) /ta.ʃaː.tˤa.rat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
